question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5
solution:
The correct answer is '**pouring**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**pouring**'.
 
• It means** '(used about a liquid, smoke, light, etc.) to flow out of or into something quickly and steadily, and in large quantities'.** ((द्रव, धुआँ, प्रकाश आदि का) तेज़ी से लगातार और बड़ी मात्रा में बाहर निकलना या अंदर आना)
 
 
• *Example: Tears were **pouring** down her cheeks.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__*** "it has been **pouring** ever since we got here..."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Slashing**: to make or try to make a long cut in something with a violent movement. (ज़ोरदार झटके से किसी वस्‍तु को चीरना, काटना या चीरने या काटने की कोशिश करना)
 
• **Drenching**: to make somebody/something completely wet. (तर-बतर कर देना, पूरी तरह भिगो देना, सराबोर कर देना)
 
• **Showering**: (of a mass of small things) fall or be thrown in a shower. (किसी पर (किसी वस्‍तु के) बहुत-से छोटे-छोटे कणों की बरसात-सी होना)
